Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center

HHSCSk
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
High
Handover reason:
Over the past 4 weeks, we have observed a total of 232 messages regarding cable temperature difference. A consistent pattern identified across all these incidents is a noticeable temperature differential between the DC+ and DC- connections, with the DC+ consistently exhibiting a higher temperature. This could be due a dusty or defective pin. Please inspect the plug and in case the pin is damaged, replace the plug.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.

additional_info.body:
Hello Emre,
Yes, I mean CCS2 plug + cable. Please check the if pins have dust inside and clean them. Perform an high current session and if you observe any issues during the session replace the cable.
If you see the pins melted/broken, then no need to test it, proceed with replacement of CCS cable.
With best regards,
